description: This source file implements helper functions, command parsing, and argument matching logic for a command-line interface shell. It includes functions for tokenizing commands, matching simple and dependent arguments, providing help and auto-completion, and indicating errors within user inputs. The code is part of a larger CLI system used in network management or similar subnetworks, with support for detailed argument validation and user feedback.
